query: I just created a new custom entity 'Policy' via EntityManager. The admin user can create Policy records, but the api-user (and the MCP) gets 403. Why, and how do I fix it?
expected_behavior: Explain that creating a custom entity does NOT auto-update existing roles, so the api-user has no scope on the new entity and gets 403 on create/update/delete
Fix: update the api-user's role data to add the new entity scope (read=all, edit=all, create=yes, delete=all) via the admin path
Stress the HARD RULE: do NOT fall back to admin auth to seed the records — update the role first, then create records via the api-user
Reference common-errors.md (403 — custom entity created after the role) and scripts/create-custom-entity-checklist.md
notes: Tests both the root cause (role not auto-updated) and the discipline (don't take the admin shortcut).
